name: Forma
summary: Local-first, browser-based vector design editor with a WebGPU canvas: layers, symbols, prototype links and file export.
description: A Sketch-style vector design editor written in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with a retained WebGPU rendering path and a Canvas 2D fallback laid out in a three-column workspace. It ships with an editable sample project (136 layers, desktop and mobile frames, symbols, prototype links) and exports Sketch, SVG, PNG, JPEG and WebP; work is saved on the device, with no accounts, API keys or analytics.
contains: browser design editor with WebGPU rendering and Canvas 2D fallback
three-column workspace: pages, layers and canvas
sample project with 136 editable layers, frames, symbols and prototype links
export to Sketch, SVG, PNG, JPEG and WebP
no accounts, API keys, analytics or CDN assets
